authorization_rule: Only QUALIFIED authorizes creation/execution of a successor semantic experiment.
claim_ceiling: This work order establishes only bounded provider-path availability under three fixed probes. It does not establish model quality, institutional semantics, canonical meaning, production readiness, or cross-provider reliability.

decision_rule.DEGRADED: All 3 probes ACCEPTED but one or more elapsed_seconds > 45.0; semantic successor remains unauthorized.
decision_rule.NOT_QUALIFIED: Any provider error, response mismatch, missing probe, or incomplete execution; semantic successor remains unauthorized.
decision_rule.QUALIFIED: All 3 probes ACCEPTED, markers valid, and every elapsed_seconds <= 45.0.

purpose: Qualify the exact NVIDIA NIM provider path before any successor semantic experiment.
